steps.content: The foul incarnation dissolves; Horo is finally free of the shadows, collapsing into Zoya's embrace.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: She'll get through this. She got through injuries one hundred times more painful.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: She will come back from this. She knows we are waiting for her to come back.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Now, it's time to deal with it...
She rises to her feet and looks towards the opened altar.
